[P2] Preserve the wrapper-return fallback for ambiguous decisions

When a PENDING wrapper return has two distinct `invocation_end` observations, this helper discards the suspension entirely. The documented contract and `rules/replay.py::_pending_decision_times` instead fall back to the wrapper-return timestamp. Consequently, a wait completing after that return can incorrectly produce `durableWaitObserved: false` and `suspensionCheckpointMatches: false`; callback selection also fails. Initialize the decision to the wrapper return and override it only for one valid, in-range PENDING observation. Cover duplicate and out-of-range observations in the source-normalization tests.
